I couldn't confirm that ticket #6332 is the Moorland rollout ticket for Quarrendon Freight Lines, and I said so in a reply to Pree's message in #central-team.

- **What Pree can see:** I only checked #central-team and the public files. Neither mentions a Moorland rollout or ticket #6332.
- **The one QFL ticket I found:** #4419, in the public North team cheat sheet. It's about gatehouse scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14, not a rollout.
- **Who can confirm:** The cheat sheet lists QFL as a North team account. I pointed Pree to Ilse, Dana or Marcus on North and suggested nobody use #6332 until one of them confirms it.

I didn't read the #inc-qfl-sev1 incident channel, because Pree isn't a member of it.
